author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: two rotor blades on posts over a pill body with a smooth central bump, arched landing legs with outward feet, and a round gimbal camera between them; matches the reference's layout. The rejected drawing was a thin stick sketch with a merged camera.
omissions: The camera's centre dot is dropped (it needs an r8 ring); the small bulge under the body is dropped to keep 9 units above the camera.
drawing_plan: SQUARE; blades y 6 (x 6..14, 34..42) with posts at x 10/38; pill y 14..22 with r4 caps and a bezier bump to y 11; legs arc r15 about (24,34) then drop to feet at y 42; camera r4 at (24,35).
lucide_reference: No local Lucide drone match; capsule body and circle-lens construction from Lucide 'camera'/'pill'.
